methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The procedure presented, starting from an evaluation of DCs' s energy baseline, provides a method for measurement and comparison of energy consumption before and after a significant improvement in a DC, in order to evaluate analytically the energy saving.

paper_type.evidence_quote: As a test of the methodology, the authors provide the results of a case study on the ENEA-CRESCO computing facility.

level_3b.evidence_quote: We analyzed the ENEA - CRESCO data center by means of the procedure indicated in this paper.

regulatory_driver.evidence_quote: The energy efficiency measurement approach described in this paper was primarily developed as a tool for the implementation, also in DCs, of a mechanism of incentives (named: white certificates) currently operated by the Italian Government to foster the adoption of actions aimed at improving energy efficiency.

enpi_enb_model_types.evidence_quote: SCP represents the Specific Computing Power or rather: the ratio between the Computing Power (CP), [GFlops] - and the Total Facility Power Consumption (TFPC), [KW] - that is equal to the total electric energy absorbed by DC.
